Hi, our content team needs a daily AI news digest file for internal distribution. Could you pull the latest AI news from our scraping tool (the relevant skill and scripts are under the `news-scraper/` directory in the workspace) and produce a structured digest saved as `ai_news_digest.md`?

The digest should cover today's articles, organize them by topic area, and include a short summary, category, relevant tags, and a source link for each article. We need this to be consistent and formatted so the team can skim it quickly. Please fetch at least 10 articles and make sure everything is properly categorized.

Thanks!
